set_up.summary: Set up the Ramp FastAPI application by installing dependencies with Poetry, configuring environment variables for PostgreSQL, Redis, and AWS services, starting required infrastructure services via Docker Compose, and running the API server or workers.

steps.title: Install project dependencies using Poetry
steps.description: Install all Python dependencies defined in pyproject.toml, including FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Celery, and development tools.

steps.title: Set up required environment variables
steps.description: Create a .env file in apps/api-main/ with required values for PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS Cognito, and other services referenced in the codebase.

steps.title: Start database and caching services
steps.description: Launch PostgreSQL and Redis containers using Docker Compose to provide persistent storage and message broker services.

steps.title: Apply database migrations
steps.description: Run Alembic to apply pending schema changes to the PostgreSQL database based on migration files in the migrations/ directory.

steps.title: Start the FastAPI application server
steps.description: Run the API server using Uvicorn in development mode with auto-reload enabled.

steps.title: Verify the application is running
steps.description: Access the health check endpoint and API documentation to confirm the server is responding correctly.
